name: @data-fair/metrics
description: A service to help monitoring HTTP requests in the data-fair stack.

scripts.dev:api: cd api && FORCE_COLOR=1 NODE_ENV=development exec ../node_modules/.bin/nodemon -e js,mjs,ts,json index.ts
scripts.dev:ui: cd ui && FORCE_COLOR=1 NODE_CONFIG_DIR=../api/config/ NODE_ENV=development exec ../node_modules/.bin/vite --port ${DEV_UI_PORT}
scripts.dev:daemon: cd daemon && umask 0 && FORCE_COLOR=1 NODE_ENV=development exec ../node_modules/.bin/nodemon -e js,mjs,ts,json index.ts
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run build-types && npm -w ui run build && npm run check-types && npm run test && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=critical

author: Alban Mouton <alban.mouton@koumoul.com>
